# Vendored libraries

Copied unmodified from npm by `scripts/vendor.mjs` (`pnpm vendor`). Don't edit them here: bump the
version in package.json and run the script again.

| File | Source | Licence | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Readability.js` | [@mozilla/readability](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mozilla/readability) 0.6.0, `Readability.js` | Apache-2.0, see `Readability.LICENSE` | pulls the article out of a page for reader view (injected by src/background/reader.js) |
